concepts.why: Uses a double literal 7.9 appropriately for an element of a double array, but nothing further about double is shown or applied.
Treats len(...) as a Java function (a Python/everyday reading); Java has no len, the array's size is the field sensorReadings.length, so the index expression does not compile.
Correctly subtracts 2 from the size to reach the next-to-last index (size - 1 is the last), applying the operator to this task without hard-coding; the whole line still fails only because of len.
